tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing
UserFlow: Weekly Commissioner Desk → Optional Content Creation & Publishing to Feed

stories.title: Initialize Power Rankings Builder for Week
stories.goal: start creating power rankings for the selected week with teams pre-populated in current order
stories.benefit: I can begin ranking teams without manual data entry and have a clear starting point
acceptanceCriteria: Power Rankings section loads with all league teams displayed in list format
Teams are initially ordered by previous week's published rankings (or by standings if first week)
Each team entry displays team logo, team name, manager name, and current record/standing
System provides visual indication that rankings are in draft/edit mode
Draft rankings are separate from published rankings and not visible to league members until published

stories.title: Drag-and-Drop Team Reordering
stories.goal: reorder teams by dragging them to new positions to reflect my power rankings
stories.benefit: I can quickly arrange teams in my preferred order with an intuitive interface
acceptanceCriteria: Each team row has visible drag handle icon indicating it is draggable
User can click and hold team row to begin drag operation
Visual feedback shows team being dragged with semi-transparent overlay and cursor change
Drop zones between teams highlight when dragging over them to show valid insertion points
Teams automatically reorder with smooth animation when dropped in new position
System updates rank numbers (1, 2, 3, etc.) automatically after each reorder action
Drag-and-drop works on both desktop (mouse) and mobile (touch) interfaces

stories.title: Add Per-Team Commentary Text
stories.goal: write custom commentary for each team explaining my ranking decision
stories.benefit: I can provide context and analysis that makes my rankings more engaging for league members
acceptanceCriteria: Each team row includes expandable text input field for commentary
Commentary field supports plain text with basic formatting (line breaks, basic punctuation)
System provides character count indicator with recommended range (50-500 characters)
Commentary autosaves along with rankings order every 30 seconds or when user stops typing for 3 seconds
Empty commentary fields are visually indicated but do not block publishing (commentary is optional)
System preserves commentary when reordering teams via drag-and-drop

stories.title: Skip Teams from Rankings
stories.goal: exclude specific teams from this week's power rankings if they are inactive or eliminated
stories.benefit: I can maintain accurate rankings that reflect only active participants
acceptanceCriteria: Each team row includes 'Skip This Team' checkbox or toggle control
Skipped teams are visually grayed out or moved to separate 'Skipped' section below main rankings
Rank numbers automatically adjust to exclude skipped teams (1, 2, 3... without gaps)
Skipped teams are not included in published rankings page or feed moment
System tracks skip status per team per week in database
User can un-skip teams and they return to rankable list at bottom position by default

stories.title: Use Keyboard Shortcuts for Rankings
stories.goal: reorder teams quickly using keyboard commands as alternative to drag-and-drop
stories.benefit: I can work more efficiently without relying solely on mouse/touch interactions
acceptanceCriteria: User can select a team row using arrow keys or Tab navigation
Ctrl/Cmd + Up Arrow moves selected team up one position
Ctrl/Cmd + Down Arrow moves selected team down one position
Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Up/Down moves team to top or bottom of list
Enter key focuses commentary field for currently selected team
Keyboard shortcuts are documented in help tooltip or keyboard shortcuts modal
Rank numbers update immediately after keyboard-based reordering

stories.title: Bulk Reorder Teams by Criteria
stories.goal: quickly reorder teams based on standings, points, or previous rankings as a starting point
stories.benefit: I can use data-driven sorting as a foundation before making manual adjustments
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Sort By' dropdown with options: Current Standings, Points For, Points Against, Previous Rankings, Custom
Selecting a sort option immediately reorders teams based on chosen criteria
Sort operation preserves any existing commentary for each team
System displays confirmation message indicating teams were reordered by selected criteria
User can undo bulk sort operation and return to previous order
Manual drag-and-drop or keyboard reordering overrides any bulk sort

stories.title: Preview Power Rankings Before Publishing
stories.goal: see how the rankings will appear on the power rankings page and in the feed moment
stories.benefit: I can verify the layout, order, and commentary are correct before making them public
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Preview Rankings' button within Power Rankings section
Preview displays rankings in read-only format matching public page layout with team order, logos, and commentary
Preview shows approximate feed moment appearance with ranking highlights and top teams featured
User can toggle between edit and preview modes without losing unsaved changes
Preview mode is clearly indicated with banner stating 'Preview Mode - Not Yet Published'
System highlights incomplete or missing elements (e.g., teams without commentary if desired)

stories.title: Validate Rankings Completeness
stories.goal: receive clear feedback if my rankings are incomplete or have errors before attempting to publish
stories.benefit: I can address any issues before publishing and avoid incomplete content going live
acceptanceCriteria: System validates that all non-skipped teams are ranked in sequential order (1, 2, 3... without gaps)
Validation checks that commentary fields meet minimum length requirements if specified by league settings
System displays specific error messages for each validation failure with guidance on how to fix
Publish button remains disabled until all validation criteria are met or user explicitly skips validation checks
Validation occurs in real-time as user makes changes with visual indicators on problematic items
User can save incomplete rankings as draft even if validation fails, blocking only publishing action

stories.title: Skip Power Rankings for Week
stories.goal: choose not to publish power rankings for the selected week without affecting other content sections
stories.benefit: I have flexibility to skip weeks when power rankings don't make sense (e.g., playoff weeks, league inactivity)
acceptanceCriteria: Power Rankings section includes prominent 'Skip Power Rankings This Week' toggle or checkbox
Enabling skip option collapses ranking interface and displays confirmation message
Skipped rankings are excluded from publish validation requirements
Publishing Commissioner Desk does not create power rankings feed moment for skipped weeks
Power Rankings page shows 'No rankings published for this week' message for skipped weeks
User can un-skip and resume creating rankings for the week without losing any saved draft data

stories.title: Publish Power Rankings to Feed and Page
stories.goal: make my completed power rankings visible on the power rankings page and create a feed moment
stories.benefit: League members can view my rankings and engage with them through comments and reactions
acceptanceCriteria: Publishing Commissioner Desk updates power rankings page with new week's rankings immediately
System creates feed moment titled 'Week X Power Rankings' with top 3-5 teams previewed
Feed moment includes link to full power rankings page and enables comments and reactions
Published rankings are locked from editing; system creates new draft version for any subsequent changes
Rank changes from previous week are calculated and displayed (e.g., 'Up 3', 'Down 1', 'No change')
System records publication timestamp and publisher user ID for audit trail
Power Rankings page defaults to most recently published week for easy member access

stories.title: Update Published Power Rankings
stories.goal: correct errors or update commentary in already-published power rankings
stories.benefit: I can fix mistakes or add new information without losing the original publication record
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Edit Published Rankings' button for weeks with published power rankings
Editing creates new draft version while keeping original publication visible to members
Draft changes are not visible to league members until republished
Republishing displays 'Updated' badge on power rankings page and feed moment with update timestamp
System maintains version history showing original publication and all subsequent updates with change log
Republishing bumps feed moment to top of feed with 'Updated' indicator to notify members of changes

stories.title: Copy Previous Week Rankings as Template
stories.goal: start with last week's rankings and commentary as a baseline for this week
stories.benefit: I can work more efficiently by making incremental changes rather than starting from scratch
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Copy From Previous Week' button when starting new week's rankings
Copying imports team order and commentary from most recent published rankings
Imported rankings are clearly marked as draft and not yet published for current week
User can modify copied rankings order and commentary independently without affecting source week
System displays notification confirming rankings were copied from specific previous week
Copy operation respects skip status but allows user to override on per-team basis
